description: The exit demo of FLR-P-8, as one batch: addElement adds the photo of a tile as an asset and a material whose texture is that photo at 12 inches, and setProperty lays it on the kitchen's backsplash - a region of W2's right face from 2' to 10' along the wall, between the counter at 36" and the cabinets at 54", creating /finishes and /finishes/right on the way. The rest of the face is the kitchen's paint.
